jobs.description:
Job description 

Join our family team as you transport specialized cargo like heated liquids across the Benelux, Germany, and France. You will navigate your routes with modern, well-equipped trucks while enjoying a steady schedule from Monday to Friday. During your first six months, you receive thorough supervision to help you settle into the role comfortably. This position offers a perfect blend of meaningful independence and high-quality equipment, ensuring you feel confident and supported every time you head out on the road.

You will work alongside a dedicated group of colleagues in an environment where safety is our main priority. We value your professionalism, offer fair compensation for all hours worked, and look forward to providing a permanent contract after your probationary period. With your ADR certification and a strong sense of responsibility, you will play a vital role in our daily operations. We cannot wait to welcome you and see you behind the wheel of one of our new trucks soon.

 Requirements 

    
• Valid CE driver's license and ADR tank certificate.
    
• Proven experience as an international CE driver.
    
• Strong focus on accuracy and safety-consciousness.
    
• Availability to work two weeks per month.
    
• Good language skills in Dutch and/or English.

Job description 

As part of our growing family, you will operate modern, well-equipped trucks to conduct international transport across the Benelux, Germany, and France. You will be responsible for handling specialized cargo, such as heated liquids, while enjoying a schedule that runs from Monday to Friday with occasional national day trips. We value your safety and professionalism, offering you thorough training and supervision during your first six months to ensure you feel completely at home within our supportive team.

You will enjoy a role that balances independence on the road with the warmth of a close-knit company culture. We offer a permanent contract following a successful probationary period and provide fair compensation for all your hours. If you hold an ADR certification and bring your reliable, responsible mindset to our team, you will be well-supported by your dedicated colleagues every step of the way. We look forward to welcoming you into our family and getting you behind the wheel soon.

 Requirements 

    
• Possess a valid CE driver's license and ADR tank certificate.
    
• Proven experience as an international CE driver.
    
• Strong focus on accuracy and safety-conscious work habits.
    
• Availability to work two weeks per month.
    
• Good command of Dutch, French and/or English.

Job description 

Love driving? We’re looking for a CE truck driver for day trips transporting pallets—full or empty, you’ll handle them all!

    
• 
        
Early start: 4–6 a.m.

    
    
• 
        
Average driving: 10–13 hours/day

    
    
• 
        
2–5 stops daily – build great client relationships

    
    
• 
        
No loading/unloading – technical support provided

    
    
• 
        
Work area: Belgium, S. Netherlands, W. Germany & N. France

    
    
• 
        
Shadow an experienced driver on your first day for a smooth start

    

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we provide the guidance you need.

Apply now and join our team!

 Requirements 

Your profile To be successful in this role, you meet the following requirements:

    
• Papers: You possess a valid CE driving license and up-to-date Code 95.
    
• Language skills: You can express yourself fluently in Dutch, French, and English. This is essential for communication during international stops.
    
• Reliability: You are punctual, keep appointments, and handle equipment with care.
    
• Technical skills: Do you already have experience with the Transics black box? Then you have an advantage!
    
• Attitude: You are an early bird who can work independently.

Job description 

The Adventures of an International Driver Are you ready to take the wheel and turn every trip into an adventure? As an international driver, you’ll be transporting goods all across Europe—think the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg, and France—behind the wheel of a sleek tarpaulin truck.

From candy to concrete, meat to zinc on pallets, no two loads are ever the same. It’s like a market of surprises—just with more driving and fewer small talk breaks!

Planning and timing are your superpowers. You’ll keep trips efficient, respect driving and rest rules, and make sure every delivery reaches its destination perfectly. Customers? Think of them as friends—you’ll want to impress every single one.

Flexibility and independence are key. Unexpected challenges? You handle them like a pro. One thing’s for sure: life as an international driver is never boring, always full of variety, and packed with adventure.

 Requirements 

Driving License CE + Code 95 Reliable, Flexible

I can communicate in Dutch, French, and English. That's convenient, right? No language barriers here, just a glass wall full of fun!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect to contribute to the ongoing evolution of its wealth management platform (Gwp - Gambit Wealth Platform).

The Solution Architect will play a key role in ensuring architectural consistency, technical governance and alignment across multiple development squads.

The main objective is to simplify and optimise the existing architecture while improving the platform's maintainability, scalability and autonomy.
Key responsibilities

• Ensure architectural consistency and alignment across multiple development squads

• Lead and facilitate Architecture Chapter meetings, promoting technical standards and best practices

• Support Technical Leads and development teams in making architectural decisions

• Analyse the existing architecture and identify opportunities to improve maintainability, performance and scalability

• Rationalise and consolidate MicroServices to reduce technical complexity and simplify operations, hosting, testing and integration

• Design, simplify and standardise APIs and integration mechanisms

• Document architectural decisions, evaluate technical alternatives and identify potential trade-offs

• Collaborate closely with developers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts and business stakeholders

• Reduce external dependencies and improve the platform's technical and functional autonomy

• Contribute to the continuous improvement and long-term evolution of the Gwp platform

Technical environment

• Backend development:

• C# / .NET Core

• Entity Framework

• MicroServices architecture

• Architecture & API design:

• REST APIs / OpenAPI

• Asyncapi / Typespec

• ArchiMate / UML

• Enterprise Architect

• Cloud & DevOps:

• Microsoft Azure DevOps

• Docker / Kubernetes

• Helm

• CI/CD

• Data & messaging:

• PostgreSQL

• Apache Kafka

• Testing:NUnit / xUnit

Ideal candidate

We are looking for a hands-on, pragmatic and technically strong Solution Architect who can combine architectural vision with a deep understanding of software development.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with multiple squads, challenging existing architectural decisions and driving improvements across a complex software platform.

 

This is a cross-functional Solution Architect position, not simply a senior .NET developer or technical lead role.

• Strong experience in software development within the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, ideally 10+ years

• Proven experience as a Solution Architect, ideally 3-5 years or more

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, MicroServices and API architecture

• Experience in analysing, simplifying and modernising complex existing architectures

• Good knowledge of containerisation, DevOps practices and cloud environments

• Ability to challenge technical decisions and propose pragmatic, scalable and maintainable solutions

• Experience working across multiple development teams or squads

• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to balance technical requirements, business needs and long-term architectural objectives

• Fluent in French and English (both required)

 

Nice to have

• Experience with architectural governance and Architecture Chapters

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture methodologies and modelling tools

jobs.description:
Location: Brussels, BelgiumDuration: 12 months, renewableWorking arrangement: Hybrid - 2 days/week on-site after onboarding.

Experience in test automation is a plus, but practical AI experience is the priority.

Senior PowerBuilder Developer

Technical leadership and application modernisation

Brussels * Hybrid * 3 days on site per week

Contract options: permanent, fixed-term or freelance | Start: as soon as possible

About the role

Help shape the next chapter of a business-critical application. You will combine hands-on PowerBuilder development and production support with technical leadership, preparing an established client/server platform for a progressive transition to Java and Angular.

The role connects existing application knowledge with future development: understanding how the system works, making its business rules explicit and helping developers carry them into the new platform.

Your responsibilities

• Resolve complex PowerBuilder issues and share production maintenance duties, following agreed support and documentation practices.
• Analyse application components and dependencies, including PBLs, PowerScript, PFC, DataWindows and DataStores.
• Identify business rules, edge cases and redundant behaviour; separate functional requirements from interface logic and historical workarounds.
• Decouple business logic from GUI controls and database access, including embedded SQL, dynamic SQL and stored procedures.
• Work with analysts and business specialists to translate existing behaviour into clear functional and technical specifications.
• Collaborate with Java/Angular developers on REST API contracts and validate regression coverage through characterisation and Golden Master tests.
• Build shared technical documentation, mentor colleagues and use static analysis and AI-assisted tools to maintain traceability between code and specifications.

What you bring

• At least 5 years of hands-on PowerBuilder development, with strong expertise in the PowerBuilder 8-2022 / Appeon environment.
• Advanced PowerScript and PFC knowledge: events, functions, structures, transaction handling (SQLCA, COMMIT, ROLLBACK), complex DataWindows (Composite, Group, Nested), expressions (Describe, Modify, Evaluate) and DataStores.
• Strong relational database and SQL skills, including transactional SQL, PL/SQL stored procedures and query optimisation.
• Understanding of stateless REST APIs, microservices, Spring Boot, Angular and JSON DTOs. Practical Java/Spring Boot and/or Angular experience, or a strong aptitude and willingness to develop these skills.
• An analytical approach, clear documentation for non-PowerBuilder developers and confident communication with business stakeholders, management and technical teams.
• French or Dutch, together with professional fluency in English.
Why consider this role

A hands-on technical lead opportunity combining production continuity, knowledge sharing and modernisation. Contribute to team development while building on your PowerBuilder expertise and expanding your involvement in Java and Angular.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Junior IT Recruiter
jobs.description:
Looking to start your career in recruitment? Enjoy talking to people, asking questions and finding out what makes them tick?

I'm looking for a Junior IT Recruiter to work alongside me at Oliver James in Brussels. You'll learn how to find, qualify and build relationships with IT professionals, helping us fill roles with the right people.

This role is 100% focused on candidates. There is no business development, client prospecting or responsibility for winning new clients. Your focus will be on building a strong candidate network within your IT specialisation and matching those people with opportunities we're already working on.
What you'll do

• Find the right people. Use LinkedIn Recruiter, our database and referrals to identify IT professionals who match our recruitment needs.

• Start conversations. Reach out to candidates, introduce relevant opportunities and get them interested in speaking with you.

• Get to know your candidates. Run qualification calls to understand their experience, technical skills, career goals, availability and salary or rate expectations.

• Build lasting relationships. Stay in regular contact with promising candidates, including those who aren't ready to move yet.

• Know who's ready for their next move. Maintain an up-to-date shortlist of qualified, engaged candidates so we can respond quickly when a suitable role comes in.

• Keep things organised. Record useful notes and next steps in our recruitment system, making sure conversations lead to proper follow-up.

• Work closely with me. Understand the requirements of each role, share what you're hearing from candidates and help identify the strongest matches

Who we're looking for

You don't need recruitment experience or a technical background. We're looking for someone who wants to learn and is willing to put in the work.

You'll be a good fit if you:

• Speak fluent French and English. Dutch is a plus.

• Enjoy speaking with people and feel comfortable picking up the phone.

• Are curious enough to go beyond a CV and understand what someone actually does and wants.

• Can stay organised while following up with several candidates at different stages.

• Keep going when someone doesn't reply or an initial approach doesn't work.

• Welcome feedback and want to improve.

• Have an interest in technology and are willing to learn the differences between IT roles.

What you'll learn:

• You'll receive hands-on training and work closely with an experienced headhunter specialising in the Belgian software engineering market.

• We'll cover how to search effectively, approach candidates, run useful qualification calls and build a network that you know well.

• You'll also develop your understanding of IT specialisations so you can have increasingly confident and relevant conversations.

• As you progress, you'll take more ownership of your candidate network and become someone people turn to when they're considering their next career move.

Interested?

Send me your CV or a short message explaining why this role interests you.

Previous recruitment experience isn't required.

I'd like to hear what makes you want to give it a go.
-
